attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"They seem to be enjoying the leverage, as usual.","severity":"minor","reason":"\"as usual\" implies a comparison with earlier behaviour that the briefing does not give; \"seem to\" hedges only the enjoyment"},{"span":"The Stonecutter Raiders hold the captives from the Ochre Hand.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as a standalone item with no marker that it is old"},{"span":"hoping to trade their prisoners for a quiet few days","severity":"minor","reason":"muddled: the Ochre Hand are the ones whose people were captured, not holders of prisoners; framed as a guess, so minor"}],"voice":3,"clarity":2,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The second item is just old news repeated, which a one-new-thing week should not do.
